definitions.explanation: The highest level of secrecy. Used for information, documents, plans, or projects that must not be disclosed under any circumstances. Stronger than 秘密 (secret).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極秘|ごくひ}だ。
{極秘|ごくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極秘|ごくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{進|すす}められていた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The development of the new product was being carried out as a top-secret project.

notes:
FORMS:
- Modifier: {極秘|ごくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (top-secret ~)
- Predicate: {極秘|ごくひ}だ
- Adverbial: {極秘|ごくひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ / {極秘|ごくひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in secret, confidentially)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{極|ごく}→極：03816_goku⟧ (extreme, utmost) + {秘|ひ} (secret). Literally "extremely secret."

USAGE:
Often used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {極秘|ごくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (top-secret documents). Also appears as a stamp or label on documents: {極秘|ごくひ} (CONFIDENTIAL / TOP SECRET). Frequently used in business, government, and military contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極秘|ごくひ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: top-secret information
- {極秘|ごくひ}⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: classified documents
- {極秘|ごくひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to carry out in strict secrecy
- {極秘|ごくひ}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: classified treatment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧: secret (general, everyday)
- ⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧: classified, confidential (official/institutional)
